notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki targeting Faeburrow Elder.
Activate all Faeburrow Elders you control to add at least {R}{R}{G}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Aggravated Assualt, untapping all creatures you control and gaining an addition combat step and post combat mainphase.
Repeat.
